title: Brick-Head Protection
tagline: For the days when your hair needs more structure than your life. This LEGO helmet is perfect for those 'I woke up like this' moments—except 'this' is a carefully constructed, color-coordinated mess. Ideal for architects who want to take their blueprints literally, or toddlers who refuse to grow out of their LEGO phase (and honestly, who can blame them?).

title: Hovercraft for the Homebound
tagline: Tired of tripping over your cat while carrying a glass of wine? This personal hovercraft lets you glide over pets, kids, and LEGO mines with the grace of a slightly tipsy figure skater. Perfect for the 'I don't want to walk' phase of adulthood.

title: Die on the Couch
tagline: For when you want to take a nap and a existential crisis at the same time, this coffin couch is perfect for a Sunday afternoon of questioning life choices.

title: T-Rex Takes Over Pool
tagline: Because your pool party wasn't weird enough, this giant inflatable T-Rex will judge your cannonballs and floaties.

title: Robo-Booty Bounce Buddy
tagline: When your dance floor needs a mechanical hype man, but your cat’s too busy judging you. Perfect for bachelorette parties where the groom’s a no-show, or office meetings that need a *spicy* distraction. Comes pre-programmed with moves like 'The Shaky McShake' and 'I Can’t Believe It’s Not a Human'.

title: Gauntlet of Questionable Life Choices
tagline: For the friend who's really into reenacting Avengers battles in their backyard, this lifesize Nano Gauntlet is a must. Imagine the look on their face when they try to balance the rent with this purchase.

title: Wash Away Your Nostalgia
tagline: For when you want to scrub the grime off your hands but also relive the frustration of trying to blow the dust out of a Super Mario 64 cartridge. Perfect for the retro gamer who also enjoys a good lather. Bonus points if you use it while yelling at your TV.

title: Flip Off the World
tagline: For when you want to subtly express disdain at your in-laws' dinner party, this giant middle finger mask is surprisingly effective. Just don't blame me when the mashed potatoes get cold.

title: Time Lord's Worst Nightmare
tagline: For when your Victorian-themed dinner party needs a touch of 'exterminate.' This brass-plated menace rolls in, spewing smoke and doom, just like your great-great-grandfather’s boiler room. Perfect for scaring off unwanted guests or finally getting your cat to use the litter box. Just don’t ask it to fetch the mail.

title: Ballistic Golf Chaos
tagline: For when you need to launch golf balls at unsuspecting neighbors or reenact a scene from Caddyshack, this cannon's got you covered.

title: Zombie Roommate (No Rent)
tagline: Perfect for when your Halloween decor budget is bigger than your will to socialize. This life-size zombie statue is the only guest who won’t ask for Wi-Fi or eat your leftovers. Ideal for convincing trick-or-treaters you’ve already been looted—or just scaring off your in-laws during Thanksgiving.

title: Levitating Plant Drama
tagline: For the office plant enthusiast who’s tired of coworkers stealing their sunlight. This floating bonsai tree hovers like a tiny, judgmental alien, silently mocking your coworker’s sad desk cactus. Perfect for the 'I don’t need friends, I have a levitating tree' phase of your life.

title: Octopus Hugs, No Regrets
tagline: For those nights when your cat’s too judgmental and your human pillow’s too… human. This tentacle plushie wraps around you like a cephalopod’s embrace—minus the ink and existential dread. Perfect for anime conventions, sleep paralysis, or just confusing your roommate.

title: Brewing in the Loo
tagline: For when you want to savor your morning coffee while contemplating the remnants of last night's dinner, this toilet bowl mug is the perfect companion for a solo, introspective moment on the throne.

title: Giant Board of Broken Dreams
tagline: For when you want to argue with friends over word definitions in a parking lot, this 10x20 foot Scrabble board is the perfect addition to your divorce proceedings or overly competitive family reunions.

title: Mask Up, Balls Out
tagline: For when you want to terrify your skincare routine, this face mask shaped like a, ahem, scrotum, is perfect for a relaxing evening of confusing your reflection.

title: Sleep Like a Starving Genius
tagline: For the art student who’s too broke to afford a real room, but still wants to pretend they’re living in a post-impressionist masterpiece. Perfect for those nights when you wake up at 3 AM convinced you’ve finally cracked the meaning of life, only to realize it’s just the coffee talking. Comes with a complimentary existential crisis.

title: Cheetos: Now for Your Face
tagline: For when your skin tone needs a little more 'finger-licking' glow. Perfect for the office holiday party where you want to look like you’ve been snacking on sunshine instead of stress-eating. Bonus: matches your Cheetos-stained keyboard. Just don’t lick your face—no matter how tempting.

title: Nightmare Fuel Lamps
tagline: Because who needs a boring desk lamp when you can have a severed baby doll head glowing on your nightstand? Perfect for those late-night horror screenplay sessions or when you want to subtly remind your roommate they forgot to do the dishes. Just don’t blame us if your therapist starts asking questions.

title: Prime Time Headgear
tagline: For when you need to protect your face from judgment while eating cereal in your backyard, dressed as a Transformer.

title: Kindergarten Ink: For Adults
tagline: Perfect for the 'artist' who wants to skip the ink and go straight to the crayon box. Ideal for tattooing your toddler's scribbles on your forearm so you can show off at PTA meetings. Just remember, this isn't a Sharpie—it's a commitment. And yes, it does smell like childhood regrets.

title: Toilet Plunger Mayhem
tagline: Because your dinner parties were missing a plunging competition, this game brings the thrill of unclogging toilets to your living room, perfect for that one aunt who always clogs the toilet.

title: Fishbot: Your Aquatic Spy
tagline: Ever lose your keys in the pond? Or maybe you're just suspicious of what your goldfish is up to when you're not looking. This underwater drone lets you snoop on aquatic life like a creepy submarine paparazzo. Perfect for the backyard detective who's tired of land-based surveillance.

title: Tentacle Temptation Heels
tagline: For when you want to make a grand entrance at the aquarium gala—literally. These heels transform your stride into a cephalopod’s embrace, ensuring you’ll be the talk of the jellyfish exhibit. Perfect for marine biologists with a penchant for fashion or anyone who’s ever wondered what it’d be like to walk like an octopus. Just watch out for the squid ink stains.

title: Monkey's Paw of Regret
tagline: For when you want to wish for infinite pizza, but end up with a fridge full of anchovies. Because who needs personal growth when you can have cursed snacks?

title: Space BnB for Doomsday Preppers
tagline: Tired of Earth's overpriced Airbnbs with questionable Wi-Fi? Book this fully functional starship for your next 'just in case' getaway. Perfect for the apocalypse enthusiast who wants to sleep in a zero-gravity hammock while pretending they're in a sci-fi novel. Just don't forget to pack your own space snacks—room service is still a work in progress.

title: Lockpick Cufflinks: For the Suave Cat Burglar
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm a refined gentleman' like discreetly jiggling your cufflinks to open that 'borrowed' vintage car. Perfect for the well-dressed locksmith or the magician who forgot their wand. Just don't wear them to your next TSA screening.

title: Centipede Candy Chaos
tagline: For the dinner party where things take a dark turn, serve gummy human centipedes. Watch as your guests question life choices.
